Release v1.3.1 - 2026-11-20

📚 Documentation:
  • docs: archive documentation versions after release v1.3.0 [skip release]

✅ Tests:
  • tests: v1.3.1 failing tests: the guard refuses sts:GetScopedCredentials (botocore 1.44.7; it issues temporary credentials), and the botocore-floor list names it [skip release]
  • tests: the botocore-floor list names the three v1.3.1 deny-list operations that botocore 1.35.0 lacks (sts:GetWebIdentityToken, lakeformation:GetTemporaryDataLocationCredentials, lakeformation:GetTemporaryGlueFunctionCredentials), so the CI boto-floor job passes
  • tests: v1.3.1 fold-in failing tests: the guard refuses payment-cryptography GetParametersForImport and GetParametersForExport, and datazone GetConnection with withSecret=true (also presigned); the read without withSecret stays allowed [skip release]
  • tests: v1.3.1 failing tests: the guard refuses sts:GetWebIdentityToken, stepfunctions:GetActivityTask and the four Lake Formation temporary-credential reads; 18 documented secret field names are masked, three broad names keep their harmless fields [skip release]

📝 Other Changes:
  • security: the read-only guard also blocks sts:GetScopedCredentials (new in botocore 1.44.7; it issues temporary credentials, as sts:GetWebIdentityToken); the changelog counts 9 blocked operations
  • changelog: v1.3.1 says that masked JSON text can change a report and the first change report after the upgrade
  • security: the read-only guard also blocks payment-cryptography GetParametersForImport and GetParametersForExport (key import and export tokens, as kms:GetParametersForImport) and datazone GetConnection with withSecret=true (connection credentials); parameter rules apply to presigned URLs too
  • security: the read-only guard blocks sts:GetWebIdentityToken, stepfunctions:GetActivityTask and the four Lake Formation temporary-credential calls (they issue a token or credentials, or take a task from a queue); 18 documented secret and token field names are masked as defence in depth

📊 Summary: 9 commits in this release
